text:
noah: Noticed duplicate reconnects after rolling proxy build to edge-3. Clients sometimes reconnect twice and same resume token appears in two sessions.

rachael: Logs? Could be keepalive TTL mismatch between edges causing lease race.

noah: Snippet:
```
router | 2026-03-21T18:11:02Z INFO lease seen token=rt-7a owner=edge-2
edge-3 | 2026-03-21T18:11:03Z INFO accepted session sess-44 resume=rt-7a
router | 2026-03-21T18:11:03Z WARN lease-claim conflict token=rt-7a delta_ms=120
client | 2026-03-21T18:11:03Z INFO reconnect attempt=2 resume=rt-7a
```

pritam: Looks like two edges racing. Quick mitigations: router-side dedupe for fast duplicates, align keepalive TTLs, add lease.conflict telemetry.

rachael: Proposed dedupe: accept first reconnect for a resume token and drop duplicates within 200ms, but exempt obvious mobile fast-reconnects. Behind feature flag router.dedupe_resume_fast_canary.

alerts-bot: sampling.adjust requested by rachael: metric=lease_conflict.trace_rate -> 0.05 ; duration=1h ; roll=true

pritam: Patch queued: router/patch-dedupe-resume canary=edge-3 flag=router.dedupe_resume_fast_canary window_ms=200

console-bot: Adding route timeline column lease.conflict and drill link to traces (hidden by default).

rachael: Canary results: duplicate-accepts down ~90% on edge-3. Tuned window to 350ms for client_type=mobile to avoid dropping legit fast reconnects.

noah: Follow-ups: roll flag to other edges after 2h stable, centralize TTL config to 10s, and add high-res alert: duplicate_session_rate > 0.1% over 5m at 10s resolution -> page.

pritam: Will add dedupe log line for metrics: "router dedupe drop token=%s reason=fast-duplicate delta_ms=%d". Leaving sampling at 5% for 1h then revert.

noah: Canary stable after 37m, metrics normalized. Thanks all. :tada:
